5. However, our goal is to craft glowstone, so we will gather 4 more pieces of glowstone dust.
6. Now that we have another 4 pieces of glowstone dust, we can craft another 1 glowstone.
7. We repeat this process until we have enough glowstone dust to craft the required amount of glowstone.

1. Gather 4 pieces of glowstone dust.
2. Craft 1 glowstone using the gathered 4 glowstone dust.
3. Gather 4 more pieces of glowstone dust.
4. Craft another 1 glowstone using the newly gathered 4 glowstone dust.
5. Repeat steps 1-4 until you have crafted enough glowstones.

This process ensures that we continuously gather and craft as needed to meet our goal.
